english.notes:
(i) This offence applies to notices under section 109 as it does to notices under section 174, see section 180(1A) of the Enterprise Act 2002.
(ii) This offence is not committed by reason of an act or omission if the Competition and Markets Authority has proceeded against the person under section 110(1) or (1A) in relation to that act or omission, see section section 116A(2) of that Act.
(iii) This offence replaces the offences under the repealed section 110(5) to (7) and section 174A(3) to (7) of the Act (H6810, H6811, H6812 and H20603).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

As the offence came into force after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
